population_role: cross-fitted gain labels + router fitting + threshold calibration
reuse_scope: ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT is the PRIMARY Phase28 ablation population. Ablations that only re-select from already-frozen outputs are ARTIFACT_RECONSTRUCTABLE (no new forward). Ablations that require a modified component forward or re-fit are NEW_FROZEN_MODEL_INFERENCE_REQUIRED and require separate authorization (see §10).

A0.note: global-only = frozen Phase21 global output already available; no new forward required

A1.note: always-refine = frozen Phase25A final refiner outputs already available; select all action-available

A2.note: random routing = seeded budget-matched selection over frozen action-available set; no training

A3.note: entropy routing = GT-free scalar proxy already in frozen router feature schema

A4.note: margin routing = GT-free scalar proxy already in frozen feature schema

A5.note: predicted-ROI-size routing = GT-free geometry proxy already in frozen feature schema

A6.note: learned paired-gain router = frozen Phase25D B_phi; H1 evidence produced in Phase25G

A7.note: A6 + resource cost = frozen Phase25G A7 result (= C8)

A8.note: A7 + post-safety = frozen Phase25G A8 result (= C9); canonical baseline

R1.note: router-without-deep-global-features requires a re-fit/re-inference of an ablation router variant under the frozen protocol (single controlled factor: feature depth)

R2.note: router-without-task_id requires retraining-free variant inference under frozen protocol (single controlled factor: task conditioning)

R3.note: scalar-only router = minimal-feature control; requires variant fitting/inference under frozen protocol

F1.note: refiner-without-p_global-channel requires a refiner variant forward; this is a REFINER-side ablation, not a router variant
